settings.move.title: Import from other apps
settings.move.subtitle: Copies titles and settings. Your media files stay where they are.
settings.move.signInAgainNote: Sign in again to continue. You'll return here.
settings.move.gone: A read you picked is gone. Pick again.
settings.move.forgetNote: Finished imports stay. You can read it again.
settings.move.undoLaterEmbedded: Paused items stay paused. You can undo this later from Earlier imports on the next screen, or after setup in Settings › Import from other apps.
settings.move.undoLaterPage: Paused items stay paused. You can undo this later from Earlier imports on this page.
settings.move.undoNote: Removes what this import added; your later changes stay. Download the report first if you want it.
